statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The denial reason code is CO-50
The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The denial was based on medical necessity
